negative_findings.description: The seed premise of a named 'Lidé a kariéra' rubric on E15.cz could not be confirmed. Searching in Czech for the exact phrase returned E15 career-adjacent content (finexpert/prace-a-mzda) and the E15 magazine, but no landing page for a rubric with that name.
negative_findings.result_summary: No E15 'Lidé a kariéra' section URL found; E15 people-moves coverage appears distributed across the byznys/finance-a-bankovnictvi desk and topic tag pages instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector built around an assumed E15 rubric URL would silently collect nothing; it must instead target the finance desk plus tag indexes.

negative_findings.description: The three highest-credibility outlets in this cell for unannounced departures — Hospodářské noviny, Týdeník Ekonom and Deník N — are subscription products. Anonymous fetches return teasers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headlines, ledes and tag/archive indexes are retrievable; article bodies are not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Event detection is still possible from headlines, but the reasons behind a departure — the analytic value of this cell — sit behind the paywall and need a licensing decision.

negative_findings.description: The Bankovnictví online 'Personálie' section, the single most sector-precise personalia column found, showed no RSS/Atom link in the fetched page markup, and item publication dates were not exposed in the listing markup (only in-body phrasing like 'od 1. srpna').
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection will require HTML listing diffing and date inference from article bodies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Raises collector fragility and makes precise event dating harder for an otherwise ideal source.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for Czech banking executive departures ('Czech business daily banking executive steps down') surfaced almost no Czech-outlet English coverage; the Czech business press does not maintain English personalia desks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language collection is effectively mandatory for this cell; English is only viable via international wires for the largest names.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that an English-only pipeline for CZ A5 would miss the overwhelming majority of events.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated banking/finance people-moves column was located at Seznam Zprávy, Euro.cz or Patria.cz; their coverage of moves is incidental within general business/market streams rather than a standing ledger.
negative_findings.result_summary: For those three outlets, keyword monitoring is the only viable approach — there is no section to subscribe to.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for recall per outlet and pushes the ledger role onto Newstream, Bankovnictví online, Měšec and MediaGuru.

coverage_gaps.description: No licensed full-text access to the paywalled Czech business press (HN, Ekonom, Deník N, parts of E15/Euro), which is where forced exits and restructuring rationales are actually explained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate a Czech press-archive/monitoring licence (e.g. Newton Media or Anopress, or direct publisher subscriptions) and record the licensing decision before building any full-text collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage found is heavily Prague/national-outlet centric. Regional Czech business press (Deník regional titles, Moravskoslezský/Brno business media) was not probed, so branch-network closures and regional bank hiring may be under-detected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on regional Czech titles for 'pobočka', 'ruší pobočky', 'propouští' plus bank names.

coverage_gaps.description: This slice built source coverage but not yet a complete CZ banking/payments actor map (banks, ČNB, ČBA, payment institutions, fintechs, and their alias/inflected Czech forms) to filter the generalist people-moves columns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an entity list with Czech declension variants (Komerční banky / Komerční bance, ČSOB, Česká spořitelna, Air Bank, Moneta, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit, mBank, Partners Banka, J&T Banka, Privatbanka, Fio, Trinity Bank, ČNB, ČBA) and use it as the filter over managementnews/itbiz/mesec streams.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific press (acquirers, card schemes, PSPs, POS/terminal vendors) is not represented; all sources found skew to banks and insurers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated sweep for Czech payments trade coverage and payment-institution personnel news beyond the banking column set.

coverage_gaps.description: Back-catalogue depth of the personalia columns (how far Newstream /stitek/personalie, Bankovnictví /personalie and Měšec /n/personalie paginate) was not measured, so historical backfill feasibility is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe pagination limits on each ledger and record earliest reachable item date before scoping a backfill.

brief: Czech people-moves intelligence for banking splits into two layers. The prestige business press — Hospodářské noviny, Týdeník Ekonom, Deník N, and to a lesser degree E15, Euro and Seznam Zprávy — is where unannounced exits, forced departures and restructuring numbers actually break (HN on the ČNB exodus around the Michl governorship; Seznam Zprávy quantifying Komerční banka's ~1,840-post reduction), but three of those are hard-paywalled and none maintains a standing personalia rubric. The de-facto ledgers are elsewhere and mostly open: Bankovnictví online's 'Personálie' column is the sector-precise one, with Newstream's /stitek/personalie and /stitek/kariera tags, Měšec.cz /n/personalie, Peníze.cz's personální-změny topic page, Management News and MediaGuru's annual marketing/PR personnel roll-ups covering the rest. Practical design: use the open ledgers plus Patria's hot-news archive for high-recall event detection, and reserve paid or licensed press-archive access for the paywalled dailies where the reasons behind a departure live. Czech-language collection is non-negotiable here — English-language coverage of these moves is close to nonexistent.
